Scope and player interaction

UI state machine

Deferred → ProposalReviewed → PrototypeApproved → EvidenceCollected → ProductionApproved → Rejected

WBP_Options observes results from URPGExpansionPolicy. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_ExpansionPolicy_Default. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
ExpansionId: pvp|raids|housing|auction|monetization
ApprovalState: documented decision, not a client toggle
RequiredProofs: security, economy, performance, art and operations as appropriate
ContentMigrationPlan: versioned impact on existing characters
Accessibility/PrivacyReview: actual deployment requirements

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGExpansionPolicyImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_OptionsLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
EvaluateExpansionGate(ExpansionId, EvidenceSet) -> Deferred|ReviewReady; documentation/design procedure
EnableApprovedExpansion(ReleaseManifest) -> Enabled|MissingApproval; server feature flag contract

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. PvP requires consent/rules, authority, lag/hit fairness, anti-abuse and separation of PvE balance before player damage can activate.
  2. Raids require measured larger encounters, group credit/loot recovery and readable 2D telegraphs; the four-player dungeon does not prove raid scale.
  3. Housing requires persistent placement limits, ownership/permissions, moderation, storage/instance lifecycle and sourced 3D art.
  4. Auction requires durable escrow, pricing/fees, expiry/returns, offline fulfillment, dupe-resistant settlement and economy operations; direct safe trade comes first.
  5. Monetization requires a separate ethical/legal/platform/payment/refund/fraud/privacy review with verified current requirements; no payment endpoints, premium currency or storefront are committed here.
  6. Leave all expansion flags disabled. A reviewed ADR and acceptance evidence must precede integration into the production catalog.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create only DA_ExpansionPolicy_Default with all states Deferred; do not create auction/PvP/housing gameplay shells during early phases.
  2. Hide unavailable UI entries rather than displaying purchase or join actions that cannot work.
  3. Add a content validation rule rejecting an enabled flag without its approval/evidence record.
  4. Retest base-game progress without any optional service so an expansion outage cannot block the original PvE loop.

Reopen Phase23 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: Architecture review only; no active production map fixture. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Unapproved flag enabled -> release validation failure.
Client sends PvP damage request with flag disabled -> UnsupportedAction and no player health change.
Auction service absent -> inventory and direct merchants/trades still work.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

No population, pricing, revenue or competitive-balance targets are established. These are go/no-go architecture gates, not promised shipped features.

Track approved scope separately from roadmap interest. Do not market or document these as implemented.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
